messages:
anna: Heads-up — planning a k6 traffic replay for the euro/us weekend window. Want to splay starts across ~12 groups over 20m so infra doesn't see a sharp ramp. Can infra run the agent pool in eu-west-1 + us-west-2?

raj: I can provision eu-west-1 and us-west-2. How many agents and what's the target RPS?

anna: Target steady 2k RPS total, peak ~3k during a 3m burst. Start groups: 12, agents: 10 per region to start (we can scale). Command I'm planning for k6: 

```
k6 run --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086 script.js --vus 200 --duration 30m
```

marta: For locust-based replays (if we mirror sessions) use headless + step-load. Example snippet: 

```
locust -f replay.py --headless -u 10000 -r 200 --run-time 30m
```

leo: FYI I observed a memory climb in last soak — heap +1.2GB over 1h on runtime-2.0. We should enable jemalloc stats and runtime heap profiling for this run. Also collect pprof snapshots every 10m.

anna: Agreed. Add env flags: RUNTIME_HEAP_PROFILE=1 and JEMALLOC_CONF=stats_print:true. Keep LOG_LEVEL=info for baseline, only enable debug if we see regressions. Tag the run metadata with `replay/splay-weekend`.

sarah: Quick telemetry ask — can we bump tracing sampling to 1% for the window? Need tail latencies and a few traces for long tails.

raj: Provisioning plan: 2 bastions (m5a.large) + g4dn.agent pool. I'll also carve out an isolated VPC subnet and firewall rules for the test traffic. ETA ~2h.

infra-bot: deploy job #5423 queued by @raj

anna: Code-review ping @marta — I pushed a small change to replay.py to stabilize KV-cache keys; need LGTM for locust driver changes before we run.

marta: Reviewing now. Quick note: randomized user seed uses time() — will switch to fixed seed for reproducible runs, pushing a tiny fix in 10m.

leo: I'll coordinate profiler collection and wire up CloudWatch + Grafana dashboards. Plan to capture: p50/p95/p99, CPU, GPU util, GC pauses, jemalloc stats, and heap profiles. Tagging @oncall in case the run trips alerts.

anna: Schedule proposal: Sat 02:00-05:00 UTC. Warmup 02:00-02:30, steady 02:30-04:30, ramp-down 04:30-05:00. If anything blocks, post here. :thumbsup:

marta: LGTM pushed. Ready from locust side.

raj: Infra ready in staging; starting warmup in 30m.

anna: Lovely — I'll start the orchestrator script at T+0 once warmup is green. Orchestrator will splay by shifting group start-times by a jitter matrix (example: [0m, 1m40s, 3m20s, ...]).

sarah: Saved replay run notes at /drive/replays/splay-weekend.md (contains payload sampling, seed, and eval prompts).

anna: Closing loop — please add a short post-run note: cost, any incidents, perf regressions, and whether KV cache helped. Thanks all!
